notes.title: Achievements bug has been fixed + Keyboard and mouse support
notes.notes: I was able to fix a bug that resolved the achievements for the game. Additionally, I added keyboard and mouse support. I am still working on a more significant update and will be making more changes; for instance, the player's rotation speed when using the mouse instead of a controller. Thank you all again for your patience.
